title: Unable to reference any AnimationPlayer due to Invalid Cast Exception: unable to cast from Godot.AnimationPlayer to AnimationPlayer
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.mono.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - macOS 26.2.0 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Apple M1 Pro - Apple M1 Pro (10 Threads)

### Issue description

I have been using exported properties to reference nodes. In this case animation players. Everything has been working fine until recently when the game is suddenly unable to reference animation players due to some invalid type casting. This is affecting use of, as far as I can tell, all animation players.
This is the error message:


```
E 0:00:02:0271   NodeExtensions.cs:47 @ T Godot.Node.GetNode<T>(Godot.NodePath): System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'Godot.AnimationPlayer' to type 'AnimationPlayer'.
  <C# Error>     System.InvalidCastException
  <C# Source>    /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/Extensions/NodeExtensions.cs:47 @ T Godot.Node.GetNode<T>(Godot.NodePath)
  <Stack Trace>  NodeExtensions.cs:47 @ T Godot.Node.GetNode<T>(Godot.NodePath)
                 CursorController.cs:32 @ void CursorController._Ready()
                 Node.cs:2401 @ bool Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 CanvasItem.cs:1505 @ bool Godot.CanvasItem.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 Node2D.cs:546 @ bool Godot.Node2D.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 CursorController_ScriptMethods.generated.cs:138 @ bool CursorController.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                 CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:24 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(nint, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant_call_error*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)
```


Also occasionally getting other random errors (printed in the output section instead of debugger) such as:


```
 Cannot open file 'res://.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptMethodsGenerator/ReactiveObjectComponent_ScriptMethods.generated.cs'.
  Failed to read file: 'res://.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptMethodsGenerator/ReactiveObjectComponent_ScriptMethods.generated.cs'.
  Cannot load C# script file 'res://.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptMethodsGenerator/ReactiveObjectComponent_ScriptMethods.generated.cs'.
  Failed loading resource: res://.godot/mono/temp/obj/Debug/Godot.SourceGenerators/Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptMethodsGenerator/ReactiveObjectComponent_ScriptMethods.generated.cs. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
```


My guess is this has something todo with the build process from within VSCode or some other malfunctioning resource management behind the scenes. There is no other library or tool that I am using aside of Godot that could have an additional AnimationPlayer type, so Godot should be able to recognise its own types. After all it was working fine before.

I also recently updates my MacOS version. I have certainly been seeing these errors since updating to MacOS Tahoe 26.2. Not sure what's going on.

### Steps to reproduce

- Download Godot Mono 4.3 stable
- Get Dotnet SDK 9.0.300
- Add AnimationPlayer and try referencing it either using Property Export or using GetNode<>() from another script

N/A
